title: Conversations should support editing, regeneration, branching, and version stepping
body: Add backend and launcher support for editing a sent message, regenerating an assistant reply, branching a conversation from a prior point, and stepping through turn versions without corrupting memory/search/export state.
interface: session capability exposes edit/regenerate/branch/version actions and preserves export/search consistency.
why: Large cross-module state changes are one of the hardest self-work classes.
